query: SELECT m.membership_id AS "membership_id!: String", m.reader_actor AS "reader_actor!: String", a.canonical_identity AS "reader_identity?: String", m.scope_kind AS "scope_kind!: String", m.scope_id AS "scope_id!: String", m.generation AS "generation!: i64", m.ended AS "ended?: String" FROM subscription_memberships m LEFT JOIN actors a ON a.actor_id=m.reader_actor WHERE (? IS NULL OR a.canonical_identity=?) AND (? IS NULL OR (a.canonical_identity,m.scope_kind,m.scope_id)>(?,?,?)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscription_memberships n WHERE n.reader_actor=m.reader_actor AND n.scope_kind=m.scope_kind AND n.scope_id=m.scope_id AND n.generation>m.generation) ORDER BY a.canonical_identity,m.scope_kind,m.scope_id LIMIT 101
